The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `ryzen-9-8945hs` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
`medium` session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 733 of 816 entries within +-5% of the previous session, each session measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 0.999 to 1.001 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). Relates to #721, #737 and #885.
